SELECT id, album_name AS albumName, album_type AS albumType, album_cover AS albumCover, introduction, album_year AS albumYear, company, language, artist_id AS artistId, song_count AS songCount, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM album
AND album_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) >= '0' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) <= '9'
AND (SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) < '0' OR (SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) > '9' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) < 'A') OR (SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) > 'Z' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) < 'a') OR SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) > 'z' OR (sort_album_name IS NULL AND album_name IS NULL))
AND COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name) LIKE CONCAT(#{letter}, '%')
ORDER BY song_count DESC, album_name
ORDER BY album_year DESC NULLS LAST, album_name
ORDER BY COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name)
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM album
AND album_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) >= '0' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) <= '9'
AND (SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) < '0' OR (SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) > '9' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) < 'A') OR (SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) > 'Z' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) < 'a') OR SUBSTR(COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name), 1, 1) > 'z' OR (sort_album_name IS NULL AND album_name IS NULL))
AND COALESCE(sort_album_name, album_name) LIKE CONCAT(#{letter}, '%')
SELECT LOWER(album_name) AS "normName", COUNT(*) AS "cnt", LISTAGG(CAST(id AS VARCHAR), ',') AS "ids" FROM album GROUP BY LOWER(album_name) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY "cnt" DESC
SELECT LOWER(album_name) AS normName, COUNT(*) AS cnt, GROUP_CONCAT(id SEPARATOR ',') AS ids FROM album GROUP BY LOWER(album_name) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC
